 Novig promo code NOLA unlocks an introductory offer where sports fans can secure a $50 bonus with a $10 deposit. Take advantage of this promotion on Friday, October 23, 2026, and start making predictions on the NBA or any other sport. 
 Novig is a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange where users trade sports-outcome contracts with one another, not against a sportsbook, so there’s no traditional house vig. Let's take a deeper dive into the details of this exclusive offer. 
 Novig Promo Code NOLA: Quick Guide For Rockets vs. Spurs 
 New Novig customers can claim $50 in trade credits by signing up with Novig promo code NOLA and making an initial deposit of $10. 
 Detail  Information  
 Novig Promo Code  NOLA  
 New User Offer  Deposit $10, Get $50 in Trade Credits  
 Minimum Deposit  $10  
 Who Can Claim  New customers only, aged 21 or older  
 Availability  All US states except NV, AZ, MI  
 Regulation  Novig operates as a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange (peer-to-peer trading, no house)  
 Terms & Conditions  21+, new Novig customers only, must be physically located in an eligible state  
 Last Verified On  October 23, 2026  
 To qualify for this introductory offer, a user must register for a Novig account using Novig promo code NOLA and deposit at least $10 to unlock the $50 in trade credits, which will credit to the Novig account shortly after the transaction is processed. This Novig promotion is strictly for individuals who are 21 or older and physically located in an eligible US state. Novig trade credits are not withdrawable cash, all terms and conditions are subject to change, and Novig users must always trade responsibly.

 Why The Novig Promo Code Is The Best Choice For Rockets vs Spurs 
 Our team personally tested the Novig sign-up flow and confirmed that registering with promo code NOLA successfully yields $50 in trade credits following a qualifying $10 deposit. This introductory offer presents a clear value case in concrete terms, as a $10 outlay unlocks $50 in promotional funds on an exchange where no traditional vig is priced into the markets. Traders can immediately deploy these newly acquired trade credits on the upcoming Houston Rockets vs. San Antonio Spurs game scheduled for Friday, October 23, 2026, or utilize them across any other NBA matchups this week. 
 How To Redeem Novig Promo Code NOLA 
 Use Novig promo code NOLA when you sign up, then make a qualifying first deposit of at least $10 to claim $50 in trade credits . 
 Check eligibility: You must be 21 or older and physically located in a state where Novig is available. Novig is unavailable in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. Have a valid ID ready for identity verification. 
 Create an account: Sign up on the Novig website or app and enter NOLA as your promo code during registration. 
 Deposit at least $10: Make your first qualifying deposit to meet the offer requirement. 
 Receive your trade credits: After the deposit clears, the $50 in trade credits will be added to your account. Use them on available Novig markets, including NBA markets. 
 Novig Promo Code NOLA: FAQ 
 What is the Novig promo code? 
 The Novig promo code is NOLA . New customers can get $50 in trade credits after signing up with the code and making a qualifying first deposit of at least $10 . 
 Do I need to deposit to claim the Novig offer? 
 Yes. New customers must make a first deposit of at least $10 to qualify for the $50 in trade credits. 
 Is Novig a sportsbook? 
 No. Novig is a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange. Users trade sports contracts with one another rather than betting against a traditional sportsbook. 
 Is Novig available in every US state? 
 No. Novig is unavailable to users physically located in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. You must be in an eligible state to use the platform. 
 How long do Novig trade credits take to arrive? 
 Trade credits typically appear within 12 to 24 hours after the qualifying trades settle.
